entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: A commercial venture working for the people of Torrezon on Ixalan, and a cover for a fanatical offshoot of the vampire Legion of Dusk.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire order of Torrezon that created the Queen's Bay Company.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: Ruler of Torrezon who ordered the Legion of Dusk to create the company.

entities.name: Alta Torrezon
entities.description: The vampire realm eager to fund expeditions to Ixalan.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The continent and plane where the company extracts goods, treasures and resources.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion after whose end Torrezon funded expeditions to Ixalan.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Ancient bat god bound in Ixalan's Core whom company fanatics wanted to return to Torrezon.

entities.name: Elena de Silos
entities.description: Director of the Queen's Bay Company.

entities.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
entities.description: Deputy director of the company who joined the expedition.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: Vampire who led the company's most notable expedition, fed victims to Aclazotz and was turned into a batlike demon.

entities.name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
entities.description: Member of the company's expedition.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: Member of the company's expedition.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A planar traveler who joined the expedition party.

entities.name: Core of Ixalan
entities.description: Underground realm of the Oltec reached through an ancient stone city.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: People of the Core who imprisoned the vampires and resisted Vito.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Ixalan empire whose soldiers were at the door to the Core.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Ixalan faction whose members were at the door to the Core.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The inner sun of the Core, attacked by Aclazotz.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Former planeswalker who killed Vito.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin, killed by Vito's followers.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: Vampire whom Aclazotz decided to find.

events.summary: Queen Miralda orders the Legion of Dusk to create the Queen's Bay Company after the invasion.
events.quote: Queen Miralda ordered the Legion of Dusk to create a new commercial venture

events.summary: The company becomes infested with fanatics seeking to return Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon.
events.quote: the company quickly became infested by bloodthirsty eschatological fanatics

events.summary: A company expedition enters Ixalan to find the temple of Aclazotz, suffering many deaths on the way.
events.quote: Embarking on an expedition to locate the temple of Aclazotz

events.summary: Kellan joins the party and the vampires talk their way into the Core with Sun Empire soldiers and River Heralds.
events.quote: The vampires convinced the party to bring them along into the Core

events.summary: The Oltec imprison the vampires; Vito escapes violently and sets out to find Aclazotz.
Vito feeds kidnapped Oltec to Aclazotz, who breaks his bindings and blesses Vito and his followers, turning them into batlike demons.
events.quote: he fed these people to the ancient god, who broke his bindings

events.summary: Aclazotz attacks Chimil while Vito's followers rampage in the Oltec city and kill Inti.
Huatli summons dinosaurs and kills Vito with her lance.
events.quote: summoning a horde of dinosaurs and killing him with his lance

events.summary: Aclazotz escapes on a Dusk Legion ship toward Torrezon, intending to find Vona.
events.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

relations.note: Ordered its creation by the Legion of Dusk.
relations.quote: Queen Miralda ordered the Legion of Dusk to create a new commercial venture
The director of the Queen's Bay Company is Director Infanta Elena de Silos.
The company's deputy director is Bartolomé del Presidio

relations.note: Worshipped and was blessed by the god.
relations.quote: the bat god bestowed his blessing on Vito and his followers
They were met with resistance by the Oltec army and by the Sun Empire party.
